title: Creating Data Driven Text with AI in Business Central
summary: This post shows how to build a Copilot in Business Central that generates personalized reminder text for overdue customer balances by combining user input with customer data from the database. It demonstrates passing customer name, balance due, last invoice date, and tone to an AI model to create natural-sounding collection letters.
key_points: Create a new Copilot codeunit that accepts customer data as parameters alongside user input to build dynamic prompts
Use TextBuilder to combine customer information (name, balance due, invoice date, tone) into a structured user prompt sent to Azure OpenAI
Configure AI temperature setting (0.7 in this example) to control how creative the model's output should be
Retrieve customer and ledger entry data from Business Central tables to feed into the AI prompt
Add a button to the Customer Card to trigger the reminder generation process with a modal page for user input
features: Copilot prompt engineering with dynamic data
User prompt builder with multiple parameters
Customer Card action for reminder generation
Modal page for user input and tone selection
